statements.text: The Government noted that some employees with pending vigilance enquiries or disciplinary proceedings were transferred or relieved without the knowledge of the Vigilance wing, which hampered the enquiries.
statements.quote: It has been brought to the notice of the Government that in some cases employees against whom vigilance enquiries or disciplinary proceedings were pending were transferred or relieved without the knowledge of the Vigilance wing, thereby hampering the enquiries.

statements.text: Consequently, all Departments are instructed that no employee with a pending or contemplated vigilance enquiry or disciplinary proceeding shall be transferred or relieved without prior clearance from the Vigilance section.
statements.quote: All Departments are therefore instructed that no employee against whom a vigilance enquiry or disciplinary proceeding is pending or contemplated shall be transferred or relieved without the prior clearance of the Vigilance section of the Department.

statements.text: Every note proposing an employee's transfer must specifically record their Vigilance clearance status.
statements.quote: Every note proposing the transfer of an employee shall specifically record the Vigilance clearance status.

statements.text: In the case of Sri K. Venkata Ramana, his transfer request was not considered in view of a pending enquiry.
statements.quote: Not considered in view of the pending enquiry.

statements.text: Clearance of the Vigilance section is mandatory for transfers.
statements.quote: Clearance of the Vigilance section is mandatory, as per the reference 3rd read above.
